tweets.text:
A rare opinion piece:

We have seen a ton of discourse regarding the new @Tesla Roadster as well as other opinion pieces that we believe are misguided. There has also been a lot of misinformation.

It is human to equate how specific features or products can fit into our own lives. However, when we do this, it is easy to discard the use cases and experiences of others.

The majority of comments revolve around the Thrust and Rocket tiers and their relevant features. These tiers are expected to be exorbitantly expensive, in the range of many supercars and hypercars. At those price ranges, these vehicles are rarely daily drivers and exist almost solely for driving on a track or specialized roads.

There is an expectation of this class of vehicle that special considerations are to be expected, including maintenance and often monthly costs. What doesn't make sense to you, may make complete sense to track drivers. We've seen countless comments about the downforce suction being "pointless", while the fully electric McMurtry has proven the technology as an industry changing (and scientific) breakthrough.

Lastly, the newly unveiled and redesigned Roadster was not delayed due to the addition of the thrusters. Elon had publicly stated that the vehicle would possess thrusters almost eight years ago, going as far as confirming across multiple posts that the vehicle would be able to hover.

This sentiment has been baked into the Roadster's plans since early on in its inception; not a secondary concept stapled on after the fact.

At the end of the day, we appreciate the design considerations of @woodhaus2 and the many benefits it brings. The prior iteration was loved by many, but we feel the redesign is uniquely Tesla.

As always, we would love your thoughts.
tweets.text_zh:
罕见的评论：

我们已经看到了大量关于新款@Tesla Roadster 的讨论，以及我们认为被误导的其他观点文章。也有很多错误信息。

人们会将特定功能或产品如何融入我们自己的生活等同起来。然而，当我们这样做时，很容易丢弃其他人的用例和经验。

大多数评论都围绕推力层和火箭层及其相关功能。在许多超级跑车和超级跑车的范围内，这些级别预计将非常昂贵。在这些价格范围内，这些车辆很少是日常驾驶，几乎仅用于在赛道或专用道路上行驶。

人们期望此类车辆需要特殊考虑，包括维护和通常的每月费用。对您来说没有意义的事情，对于追踪司机来说可能完全有意义。我们已经看到无数关于下压力吸力“毫无意义”的评论，而全电动 McMurtry 已经证明该技术是一个改变行业（和科学）的突破。

最后，新推出和重新设计的 Roadster 并没有因为增加推进器而延迟。埃隆大约八年前就曾公开表示，该飞行器将配备推进器，甚至在多个帖子中确认该飞行器将能够悬停。

自 Roadster 诞生之初起，这种情绪就已融入到其计划中。不是事后钉上的次要概念。

最终，我们欣赏@woodhaus2 的设计考虑以及它带来的许多好处。之前的迭代受到了很多人的喜爱，但我们认为重新设计是特斯拉独有的。

一如既往，我们会喜欢您的想法。
